	<ResortReportHeadline>Great turns and early start on Village Chair!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>The wind has picked up and there is some high cloud moving in from the north, but I reckon it'll be a mostly fine day with plenty of good turns to be had.&nbsp; The current temperature is minus 1.3, heading for a top of 4 degrees, and the wind is a moderate to strong northerly.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>The snowmakers had a run for a few hours overnight, so I expect the groomers will be in good shape again this morning, and there will still be good dry packed snow to be found in many off-piste zones too.&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p><b>Village Chair is scheduled for 7:30am First Tracks today.</b> Keep an eye on the <a href="https://www.mthotham.com.au/mountain/conditions/lifts-terrain" rel="nofollow">Lift Status page</a> and the <a href="https://www.mthotham.com.au/mountain/explore/download-the-app" rel="nofollow">Hotham App</a>, as the wind may impact some upper and outer lifts if it increases much more.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Rug up for the windchill this morning and have another beaut day out there!</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>

	<Backcountry>2 August 2026
The conditions in the backcountry are variable, but you may find some good turns out there.  Some aspects are still holding dry snow, while others have moved into a melt freeze cycle and will be slick to start the day.  The cover is good up high but becomes much more marginal at lower elevations.  Beware of a sliding hazard.  Take Care.  </Backcountry>
